current_prompt.body:
READ the list L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64}
NOTE that L contains 45 distinct positive integers
SET N=15
DETERMINE whether the set L can be partitioned into N disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) for i = 1 to N such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple
IF a valid partition exists THEN
    EMIT one complete example of such a partition
ELSE
    REPORT that no valid partition exists

current_plan.body:
READ the list L of integers
SET N to 15
GENERATE all candidate triples (a, b, c) from L such that a + b = c
BUILD a collection of these candidate triples
SEARCH for a set of N disjoint triples that together cover all elements of L
IF a valid selection is found THEN
    EMIT one complete example of such a partition
ELSE
    REPORT that no valid partition exists
